## v0.5.1 · Desktop and Turn Reliability

v0.5.1 is a coordinated patch release for the `dsh-mnemon` Starter and all sixteen official Source, Strategy, and Provider packages. It fixes two user-visible failures on the stable DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 line without changing configuration or persisted data.

### Fixes

- [#176](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/176): mount the Memory System launcher through the released Desktop Sidebar's actual nested parent. Settings no longer fall back to a read-only state after an `insertBefore` `NotFoundError`.
- [#172](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/172): abort and settle an in-flight Idle Review before the next ordinary turn binds the same Agent runtime. The new turn no longer fails with `Mnemon runtime is already pinned`.

### Verification and delivery

- Both regressions were reproduced and corrected in isolated real DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 WebUI profiles, with before/after screenshots and focused regression tests in [PR #177](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/177) and [PR #178](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/178).
- PR CI now keeps two complementary heavy jobs and verifies independent packed plugins through a bounded four-worker queue. The measured critical path fell from 6m14s to 3m01s while retaining integrated source, public-entry, standalone package, external-consumer, and real DSH checks ([PR #179](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/179)).

### Install or upgrade

`v0.5.1` is published on the npm `latest` channel:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.1
```

Use `headless` instead of `web` for a Headless profile, then restart DSH. No storage migration is required. Back up the effective memory root, Documents, DSH profile/configuration, and separately managed Provider data before upgrading.

Full compatibility and rollback details are in the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.1/docs/en/releases/v0.5.1.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.1/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.1.md).
